I've replied to Tobias in a thread on his message: the depot was Southgate. On 2025-09-03, during the outage, Priyanka posted in #inc-tansley-carrier-api that Southgate dispatch had unlabelled totes stacked beside door 4. She later posted that Southgate had cleared the backlog.

The channel doesn't give Southgate's street address or any other site details. I also checked the shared files and found no Tansley account files, so I suggested Tobias ask Priyanka for the address.
